text: True or False: For a general-purpose photonic computer operating at 4 to 8 bits, squeezed light pushed below the standard quantum limit addresses the bottleneck that actually binds the machine.
explanation: False. A general-purpose computer at 4 to 8 bits operates far above the standard quantum limit, so squeezing below the SQL addresses a bottleneck that is rarely the one that binds. Squeezing (Caves, 1981) is a genuine resource for metrology and only helps in one quadrature at the cost of the conjugate and of extremely low loss, not for low-precision computing.
